name: Kaliningrad UGS Gas Pipeline Branch

researcher_notes: Re-checked match-to-existing: roster has only P0750 (Minsk-Kaliningrad interconnection, 155 km trunk); no UGS branch row, so not matched. Two outlets but same commissioning story, so independent=false; one validated ref suffices (high). Sponsor Gazprom (owner inferred from UGS operator; entity 'Gazprom PJSC' exists); built/operating line GEM never captured, so passes add-threshold (a)-(d): length 26 km >=25 sourced. Start tie-in point on the Minsk-Vilnius-Kaunas-Kaliningrad trunk, diameter, capacity, start year and route NOT found: leave blank; RouteType/RouteAccuracy = no route (needs official GIS/OSM trace in a routes pass).
